name: Base64 Encoder/Decoder
description: Encode text to Base64 or decode Base64 back to text, with full UTF-8 support — instantly, in your browser.

faq.question: Does this handle emoji and non-English text correctly?
faq.answer: Yes — text is UTF-8 encoded before Base64 encoding (via TextEncoder/TextDecoder), so accented characters, emoji, and non-Latin scripts round-trip correctly. A naive browser btoa()/atob() call alone only handles single-byte characters and mangles anything else.

faq.question: What happens if I try to decode invalid Base64?
faq.answer: You'll get a clear error message instead of garbled output — the decoder validates the input before attempting to convert it.

faq.question: Is my text uploaded anywhere?
faq.answer: No — encoding and decoding both happen entirely in your browser. Nothing is sent to a server.
